The climate in Stavros

Stavros is about 7 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 32°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 4°C. Around 740 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in March (about 95 mm). The highest temperature in Stavros in 2015–2024 was 41°C (3 August 2021) and the lowest −7°C (15 February 2021).

Best time to visit Stavros

The most pleasant weather in Stavros is usually in May, September and October: average highs are between 21°C and 27°C, with up to 10 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
